claims.claim: Google awarded XBOW $250,000 for a Chrome full-chain exploit, described by XBOW as the first award under Google's 2026 rules.
XBOW reconstructed the six-day campaign's API charges from archived Codex logs at roughly $40,000.
The awarded chain was built between Sunday August 2 and Friday August 7, 2026, after a two-month first chain failed on a duplicate.
Dolan-Gavitt estimates that pre-LLM a Chrome full chain took a team of four around 6-9 months.
Chrome Releases lists CVE-2026-85045 as a High-severity race condition in V8 reported by Brendan Dolan-Gavitt of XBOW on 2026-08-17, fixed in the 2026-09-03 stable update.
Chrome Releases lists CVE-2026-78952 as a High-severity out-of-bounds write in Crashpad reported by Dolan-Gavitt on 2026-08-13, fixed in the 2026-08-25 stable update.
GPT-5.6 Sol's discounted API price is $4 input / $0.40 cached / $20 output per million tokens, down from $5/$30, available at least through November 21, 2026.
OpenAI rates GPT-5.6 Sol High but not Critical for cybersecurity; in Chromium/Firefox testing it found bugs and primitives but did not autonomously produce a full chain.
Hacktron's GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra n-day V8 benchmark completed a chain for $1,596.89 of model compute over about 2.1 billion tokens.
Crowdfense offered $2-3 million for Chrome exploits leading to RCE and LPE in its 2024 acquisition program.
Pwn2Own Berlin 2026 paid $175,000 for a Chrome sandbox escape, $125,000 for Chrome plus Windows kernel EoP, and $75,000 renderer-only.
Google's VRP paid a record $17.1M to 747 researchers in 2025, with Chrome VRP paying $3,716,750; 2024 Chrome VRP paid $3.4M for 337 valid bugs.

In its 2026 VRP revision Google cut the Chrome memory-safety base reward to $500, phased out RCE and arbitrary read/write bonuses citing AI-driven submissions, and kept full-chain rewards at up to $250,000.
Chrome Security said its reward changes reflect the volume of reports found and fixed with internal AI tooling and that Big Sleep now runs as a fully automated pipeline on V8.
Anthropic reported a thousand Mythos Preview runs on OpenBSD cost under $20,000 and a Linux kernel n-day chain cost under $2,000.
GTIG tracked 90 zero-days exploited in the wild in 2025 (78 in 2024, 100 in 2023), with browsers under 10%.
XBOW raised a $120M Series C at a valuation over $1 billion on March 18, 2026.
BLS median annual wage for information security analysts was $129,180 in May 2025.
A Chrome Mojo sandbox escape (CVE-2025-4609) earned a $250,000 reward in 2025.
